subject: Human Evolution
title: Tools as Social Markers
description: A micro-lesson that makes Tools as Social Markers usable.

hook.text: Some hand axes are too large to use. They were probably made to impress, not to cut.

buildup.text: Crafting a perfect, oversized hand axe demonstrates skill, patience, and access to fine materials.

discovery.text: Like a peacock's tail, costly-to-make tools may have signaled fitness to potential mates or allies.

twist.text: This 'sexy hand axe' hypothesis is contested, but display behavior in tools appears across many cultures.

climax.text: Technology has always been part identity, part function. Status signaling through objects is ancient.

punchline.text: Even cavemen showed off their gadgets.

quiz.question: What is the 'sexy hand axe' hypothesis?
options: Axes were used for mating rituals
Oversized tools signaled skill and fitness to mates
